acts.name: First Lanterns

banner.line: Nine souls and one lamp lit. Two more lanterns and this place stops being a camp.

acts.summary: A second field, still water, and a bed for every hand.

acts.name: A Village Worth Keeping

banner.line: A village that cannot store a harvest is a village that watches it rot.

acts.summary: Food that lasts, hands that stay, stores that hold.

acts.name: The First Horn

banner.line: Thornband on the north road. Not a raid yet - a rehearsal. Wall the line and prove it.

acts.summary: The horn sounds for a reason. Hold the line.

acts.name: Beyond the Lanterns

banner.line: The eastern road has gone quiet. Send a Wayfinder beyond the wall.

acts.summary: Scout the frontier and claim what the chart can prove.

acts.name: Masters of the Manor

banner.line: Six trades under one roof, and every one of them held to a standard.

acts.summary: Masters, specialists, and the Orrery turns.

acts.name: Beyond the Chalk

banner.line: Three tiers down, and further yet. The dark water keeps its own larder.

acts.summary: Cold wood, white-hot plate, and water older than the manor.

acts.name: War Comes Home

banner.line: They brought a ram. They brought it because timber gates are kind.

acts.summary: Siege doctrine, target priority, and layered stone.

acts.name: Dawn of the Manner

banner.line: Twelve hands on the chalk. One gate. Dawn.

acts.summary: Prestige, the Sunken Chapel, and the Dawn Gate.

acts.name: The Pale Court

banner.line: The Court does not raid. It arrives, and it stays.

acts.summary: Elite combined arms and regional war.

banner.line: Every name I ever rang for is on this page. There is room left.

stoneworking.name: Stoneworking
stoneworking.behavior: Quarrymen cut real Stone, and paved roads carry the village faster.
stoneworking.description: Unlock the Stone Quarry and a new mineral supply.

road_masonry.name: Road Masonry
road_masonry.behavior: Builders convert heavily used dirt trails into permanent stone roads on their own.
road_masonry.description: Pave established dirt paths. Friendly units travel 15% faster on stone.

moon_orchards.name: Moon Orchards
moon_orchards.behavior: Every farm and grove feeds the village faster, and bellies stay full through lean nights.
moon_orchards.description: Cultivate a dependable new food source and steady the village larder.

fieldcraft.name: Fieldcraft
fieldcraft.behavior: Traps arm and reset faster, so a single charge stops mattering.
fieldcraft.description: Prepare traps and better melee weapons.

forging.name: Forging
forging.behavior: The forge refines master tools and armor kits the whole village can put to work.
forging.description: Improve the tools of smiths and armorers.

education.name: Education
education.behavior: Apprentices train for less, reach their trade sooner, and the school opens its benches.
education.description: Open a school and recruit apprentices.

wayfinding.name: Wayfinding
wayfinding.behavior: Scouts report which side the horns come from, and the warning says so.
wayfinding.description: Train Wayfinders and read the frontier before it arrives.

village_medicine.name: Village Medicine
village_medicine.behavior: Healers post a recovery bell, and the wounded mend far faster between horns.
village_medicine.description: Train the choir and establish a recovery bell.

organized_supply.name: Organized Supply
organized_supply.behavior: Remote production keeps feeding the Manor instead of sitting at full stores.
organized_supply.description: Ration and route the village larder so nothing spoils at the workplace.

fortifications.name: Fortifications
fortifications.behavior: Builders are equipped for large projects and lay a whole wall row from one pick.
fortifications.description: Replace exposed timber with stone defenses.

organized_watch.name: Organized Watch
organized_watch.behavior: Guard Posts fill themselves from idle defenders, warnings name the side, and squires carry a blade worth the name.
organized_watch.description: Hold the perimeter with signal defenses and heavy weapons.

smelting.name: Smelting
smelting.behavior: Smelters pour plate for less, and the armor racks get what the wall needs.
smelting.description: Recruit smelters to turn the workshop economy toward plate.

apprenticeships.name: Apprenticeships
apprenticeships.behavior: Trained apprentices promote into specialist trades on their own.
apprenticeships.description: Bind apprentices to masters so trades pass down in the village.

deep_woodcraft.name: Deep Woodcraft
deep_woodcraft.behavior: Woodcutters read the grain and take rarer heartwood from the same stands.
deep_woodcraft.description: Work the cold treeline without stripping it.

waterway_maps.name: Waterway Maps
waterway_maps.behavior: Charted water routes let expeditions run deeper, and divers work a proper net.
waterway_maps.description: Chart the black water before anyone swims it.

field_medicine.name: Field Medicine
field_medicine.behavior: Defenders who fall in a raid are carried to the chapel and returned to the line.
field_medicine.description: Treat the wounded on the wall instead of after it.

granary_planning.name: Granary Planning
granary_planning.behavior: Granaries hold a deeper reserve, so growth never stalls on a thin month.
granary_planning.description: Plan the year's stores against the years you cannot predict.

gate_engineering.name: Gate Engineering
gate_engineering.behavior: Gates brace themselves while a ram works on them, buying seconds for the towers.
gate_engineering.description: Build gates that outlast the thing that is hitting them.

watchtower_doctrine.name: Watchtower Doctrine
watchtower_doctrine.behavior: Towers shoot siege engines and breakers first instead of whoever is nearest.
watchtower_doctrine.description: Give the towers a target list worth having.

tool_standardization.name: Tool Standardization
tool_standardization.behavior: Repair crews spend far less timber for the same wall, and every tool in the manor fits one gauge.
tool_standardization.description: One tool, one standard, one price for a repair.

frontier_commerce.name: Frontier Commerce
frontier_commerce.behavior: Trade and caravans keep running while the village is busy elsewhere.
frontier_commerce.description: Bring markets and specialist traders to town.

frontier_surveying.name: Frontier Surveying
frontier_surveying.behavior: The campaign table names faction, strength and prize at every camp, and cairns mark the surveyed road.
frontier_surveying.description: Survey the frontier so expeditions stop being guesses.

settlement_resilience.name: Settlement Resilience
settlement_resilience.behavior: After a lost raid the village rebuilds faster and the people do not scatter.
settlement_resilience.description: Make losing a raid a cost instead of a collapse.

combined_arms.name: Combined Arms
combined_arms.behavior: Front-line units screen the archers instead of both chasing the same raider.
combined_arms.description: Fight as one line: spears in front, bows behind.

siege_doctrine.name: Siege Doctrine
siege_doctrine.behavior: Rams and bombards are answered by the gate crews first, before anything else.
siege_doctrine.description: Answer siege engines with a plan instead of a panic.

master_workshops.name: Master Workshops
master_workshops.behavior: One global crafting panel runs every workshop in the manor instead of visiting each.
master_workshops.description: Put every trade under one ledger.

guild_charters.name: Guild Charters
guild_charters.behavior: Chartered trade families train cheaper and their prestige carries further.
guild_charters.description: Charter the trades so skill stays in the village.

regional_outposts.name: Regional Outposts
regional_outposts.behavior: Secured regions send real supply and real warnings back to the manor.
regional_outposts.description: Hold ground outside the wall and make it pay.

civic_engineering.name: Civic Engineering
civic_engineering.behavior: Builders keep working through their queue without being reassigned by hand.
civic_engineering.description: Give builders a standing order and let them run it.

fortress_command.name: Fortress Command
fortress_command.behavior: Choose a war plan before the horn: which post holds, which post screens, what towers ignore.
fortress_command.description: A manor that fights on paper before it fights on the wall.

automated_crafting.name: Automated Crafting
automated_crafting.behavior: After a raid, masons walk the damage and put it back without being told.
automated_crafting.description: Let the manor mend itself between horns.

civic_administration.name: Civic Administration
civic_administration.behavior: Town meals and civic duties run to a standing schedule instead of asking daily.
civic_administration.description: A settlement that governs itself on a calendar.

far_horizon.name: Far Horizon
far_horizon.behavior: Expeditions reach Pale Coast and return with prizes no near road could carry.
far_horizon.description: Send people where the chart ends.

royal_forge_quarter.name: Royal Forge Quarter
royal_forge_quarter.behavior: Permits the Royal Forge Quarter, and every workshop refines at the quarter's rate.
royal_forge_quarter.description: A quarter of forges under one charter.

great_works.name: Great Works
great_works.behavior: Permits the first Great Work, and every later one costs less stone to start.
great_works.description: The charter that lets a settlement build something that outlasts it.

manor_legacy.name: Manor Legacy
manor_legacy.behavior: Prestige no longer resets: the manor's record outlives the troop that set it.
manor_legacy.description: What the village remembers, the manor inherits.

doctrines.name: Hold The Line
doctrines.text: Walls, gates and defensive crews are held to a harder standard: braced gates, faster repairs, deeper reserves.

doctrines.name: Open Roads
doctrines.text: Travel, trade and logistics improve. Roads carry more and caravans arrive sooner.

doctrines.name: Night Watch
doctrines.text: Better raid warning and tower awareness. The horn names the side before it sounds.

doctrines.name: Full Granaries
doctrines.text: Food stability and growth. Bellies stay full through a lean month.

doctrines.name: Master Craftsmen
doctrines.text: Crafting, construction and repair improvements across every trade in the manor.

doctrines.name: Frontier Reach
doctrines.text: Scouting and expedition improvements. The frontier gives more and costs less.

starwatch-ridge.name: Starwatch Ridge
starwatch-ridge.text: Chalk marks on the high stones: horn counts and the names of watchmen who stood here too long.
starwatch-ridge.benefit: Better raid warning and attack-direction intelligence.
starwatch-ridge.developsTo: Watch posts feed the manor warnings before the horn, and hold the ridge road open.

whisperwood.name: Whisperwood
whisperwood.text: The pines carry sound farther than they should. Wayfinders leave paired cuts on safe trunks.
whisperwood.benefit: Rare wood and the advanced forest professions.
whisperwood.developsTo: Heartwood and the wardens who can read it.

ashfall-march.name: Ashfall March
ashfall-march.text: Charcoal lies under the grass in black seams. The ground remembers every fire asked to burn too long.
ashfall-march.benefit: Industrial resources: ore, timber and the forge fuel chain.
ashfall-march.developsTo: The Ember Legion's own supply lines, turned.

blackwater-mouth.name: Blackwater Mouth
blackwater-mouth.text: Broken pilings vanish beneath the black current. Fishers tie a white thread to the first post.
blackwater-mouth.developsTo: Deep soundings and the boats that carry them.

southreach.name: Southreach Crossing
southreach.text: Four old roads meet under one weathered marker, and every road arrives owing something.
southreach.developsTo: A crossroads that pays for the privilege.

dawnfields.name: Dawnfields
dawnfields.text: The eastern fields take the first light over the chalk. The gate faces them by design.
dawnfields.benefit: Grain, growth and the settlement's food security.
dawnfields.developsTo: Fields that feed the manor through a lost raid.

pale-coast.name: Pale Coast
pale-coast.text: Salt grass and precise rows of banners. Supplies are arranged by rank.
pale-coast.benefit: Late-game Pale Court progression and the Court's own prizes.
pale-coast.developsTo: The road the Court would rather you did not hold.

stone-road-network.name: Stone Road Network
stone-road-network.text: Changes the transport system: every paved trail becomes a real supply route.

city-wall-project.name: City Wall Project
city-wall-project.text: Changes the settlement's defense structure: the wall line becomes continuous and self-repairing.

royal-forge-quarter.name: Royal Forge Quarter
royal-forge-quarter.text: Changes crafting and industry: every workshop refines through the quarter.

grand-watchtower.name: Grand Watchtower
grand-watchtower.text: Improves warning, targeting and frontier intelligence for the whole manor.

dawn-gate.name: Dawn Gate
dawn-gate.text: Campaign milestone and settlement visual transformation.

manner-citadel.name: Manner Citadel
manner-citadel.text: Major endgame transformation of the settlement.

grand-granary.name: Grand Granary
grand-granary.text: Deep reserve storage that changes supply stability.

manor-gardens.name: Manor Gardens
manor-gardens.text: Growth and recovery for the whole settlement.

market-square.name: Grand Market Square
market-square.text: Changes trade: frontier goods reach the manor faster and pay better.

monument.name: Monument of the Manner
monument.text: Carries prestige forward instead of resetting it.

templates.name: Supply the Caravan
templates.text: A road cart needs timber before moonrise.

templates.name: Produce the Goods
templates.text: The order book has more on it than the forge.

templates.name: Train the Watch
templates.text: Six new faces, no drills yet.

templates.name: Mend the Breach
templates.text: There is a hole in the wall and it will not keep.

templates.name: Hold Through the Horn
templates.text: Let them come to the gate and hold it.

templates.name: Break the Archetype
templates.text: Kill the thing that teaches the rest.

templates.name: Run the Expedition
templates.text: Three days out, if the chart holds.

templates.name: Scout the Landmark
templates.text: Somebody has to go and look at it.

templates.name: Deliver the Materials
templates.text: The outpost wants it by the new moon.
